sections.shortTitle: Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies Elections Third amendment Order 1985
sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 4, Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Third amendment) Order 1985
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 4 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 4
OF 1985
HOUSES
OF PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (THIRD AMENDMENT.) ORDER,
1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th January, 1985]
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) (Third Amendment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 10, P. (P. P.) 0. No. 5 of 1977.--In the
Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P.
P.) O. No. 5 of 19771, in Article 10,-
(a) in clause (1),-
(i) the commas.
words and figure "as provided in Article 62 of the Constitution,"
shall be omitted ;
(ii) in
paragraph (b), the word "and" at the end shall be omitted ;
(iii) after
paragraph (c), the following new paragraphs shall be added, namely
"(d) he is of good character and is
not commonly known as one who violates Islamic Injunctions ;
(e) he has adequate knowledge of Islamic
teachings and practices obligatory duties prescribed by Islam as well as
abstains from major sins ;
(f)
he is sagacious, righteous and not profligate and honest and ameen ;
(g) he has not been convicted for a
crime involving moral turpitude or for giving false evidence ; and
(h) he has not,
after the establishment of Pakistan, worked against the integrity of the
country or opposed the Ideology of Pakistan
Provided that
the disqualifications specified in paragraphs (d) and (e) shall not apply to a
person who is a non-Muslim, but such a person shall have a good moral
reputation." ; and
(iv) the words
and figure "and has made oath as provided for in Article 7" shall be
omitted ; and
(b) in clause (2), in paragraph
(b),
(i) in
sub-paragraph (b), for the semicolon and word " ; or" a colon shall
be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added, namely :-
"Provided
that the disqualification in this sub-paragraph shall not apply to a person who
has, at any time since the fifth day of July, 1977 been a member of the Federal
Council (Majlis-e-Shoora) or a Provincial Council or a Federal Minister a
Minister of State; an Adviser or a Provincial Minister; or" ; and
(ii) after
subparagraph (b), amended as aforesaid, the following new sub-paragraph shall
be inserted, namely :-
"(6-A) he
has, at any time after the first day of December, 1971, and before the fifth
day of July, 1977, been a Federal Minister, a Minister of State, an Adviser or
a Provincial Minster ; or".
